seo.title: KIGALI — UBUFASHA KU BANTU BATAGIRA AHO BABA - No Home Help
seo.description: Aho wabona ubufasha bwihutirwa, icumbi, ibiribwa, ubuvuzi, umutekano n’amategeko byagenzuwe i Kigali.

page.heading: KIGALI — UBUFASHA KU BANTU BATAGIRA AHO BABA
page.urgent: Iyo hari akaga kihutirwa, hamagara serivisi z’ubutabazi ziri hasi. Intambara, ikirere cyangwa ibihe by’aho bishobora guhagarika serivisi.
page.notice: Amakuru, amasaha, ibisabwa n’imyanya bishobora guhinduka. Hamagara mbere yo kugenda. Urutonde ntirwemeza uburiri, ibiribwa, amafaranga, ubuvuzi cyangwa akazi.
page.intro: Tangira kuri serivisi ibereye iri hasi. Vuga ko uri i Kigali, niba ufite aho utekanye urara iri joro, n’icyo ukeneye mu buzima, umutekano, ubumuga cyangwa kurinda umwana.
page.footer: Buri nyandiko ifite isoko ry’amakuru. Nta cumbi ryemejwe nta suzuma.

entries.title: Rwanda Women’s Network
entries.description: Rwanda Women’s Network itanga cyangwa ihuza ubufasha bwa icumbi n’amacumbi i Kigali. Hamagara wemeze ibisabwa, aho iri n’uko serivisi ihagaze. Icumbi n’ubufasha ku bahuye n’ihohoterwa; hamagara kugira ngo basuzume ikibazo n’umwanya.
entries.how_to_access: Hamagara cyangwa urebe urubuga rwemewe mbere yo kugenda. Baza ubufasha buhari uyu munsi n’inyandiko zikenewe.
